methodology.purpose: Second complementary player-facing retrieval question for every atomic chunk.
methodology.authoring_source: Only source_text, retrieval_text, and intrinsic chunk metadata.
methodology.benchmark_use: Benchmark failures were used only to identify broad mismatch categories before authoring; no case IDs, gold IDs, states, or benchmark messages were used as authoring inputs.
methodology.selection_rule: The second question is a natural alternate angle on the same atomic fact, with wording complementary to the first question and without benchmark-case-specific phrasing.
